title: TIPAESHKERE
description: The eshkere mod is a really cool mod that adds new cool tools like yeshkerepickaxe and goidapon to explore the new dimension of ponworld and much more.
body:
Items added by this mod
eshkere tools namely yeshkerepickaxe and eshkeresword
![ESHKERESWORD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70a635ded32dcce77c6be0a2479a49b667ec4130.png)
![YESHKEREPICKAXE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b62418006d3e74b379f2ec6b2bb22673174feae.png)
Golden Sword v2 is an improved version of the Golden Ball.
![GOLDENSWORDV2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ab4b57d2f9ba781081026afb91bf8258ff7b892.png)
Pickaxepickaxe , sword of swords, and ultrapon are very expensive and difficult to obtain tools, but they are worth it because they are much better than any other
![PICKAXEPICKAXE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7aaaf71f6e2f66120cfc4e8a954f937d3821e30c.png)
![SWORDOFSWORDS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35629dea05d11ffa4c6997ac16d65d88411dff64.png)
![ULTRAPON](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/036d0527270fdeafdd24f527b46baa6cbfbd30a3.png)
The new dimension of Ponworld is the best dimension with infinite resources and the same large number of structures.
![PONWORLD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1fd1dba06d9724ec14323067ab4b399111704cb0.png)
